cause: a preview server, a PowerShell process running C:\ProgramData\DBeePatient\preview.ps1, holds 127.0.0.1:18080, so DBeePatientWeb cannot bind (only one usage of each socket address) and the Service Control Manager restarts it into the same failure
cures_ok: Stop-Process the preview.ps1 PowerShell (the squatter) then Start-Service DBeePatientWeb
cures_never: change patient-web's port without finding the squatter
